scope: Native scalar store fault-PC retention, acknowledged retirement without output redispatch, and explicit V4/V5 compatibility.

primary.contract: Data abort returns to the faulting instruction. RAX execution.rs defines dispatch before acknowledgement.

assumption_register.assumption: A caller acknowledgement means output has already been dispatched successfully.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Persist acknowledged status before fallible PC publication.
assumption_register.stress_test: PC setter fails before or after mutation, then checkpoint/reentry/retry.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A completed device output is dispatched again after a failed PC write.
assumption_register.qualification: Actual VMM dispatch precedes acknowledgement. Portable setter errors before/after mutation and actual owner-thread failures before and after a successful SDK PC mutation, with file continuation conserve one dispatch. Failed or partial device dispatch is outside this acknowledgement contract.

assumption_register.assumption: V4/V5 native store records already advanced PC at trap and require no further retirement write.
assumption_register.basis: Frozen exact producers, emitted output fixtures and actual V5 hardware record atPC4 before acknowledgement.
assumption_register.stress_test: All legacy input/output phases and explicit legacy PC redirects.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: Import or acknowledgement changes the retained legacy PC or another field.
assumption_register.qualification: Exact V4/V5 producer fixtures decode in the owning library. Actual V5 CPU-record imports preserve ordinary and redirected PC; no whole legacy VM-file claim.

assumption_register.assumption: An externally observed output effect survives VM replacement; the fixture reattaches the same host sink.
assumption_register.basis: Existing PL011 snapshot contract excludes replaying host output; the new probe models that external observation.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Count one device dispatch across native PC failure and file continuation.
assumption_register.stress_test: One/two/four CPUs and a prepared post-write PC frontier.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: The target dispatches the already acknowledged output again.
assumption_register.qualification: One/two/four-CPU files reattach the same external sink. A real SDK PC write followed by a test-wrapper error exercises the post-write frontier; no arbitrary callback serialization or claim that the SDK itself returned an error after mutation.

acceptance.frontier: Require IL4. Stage next=(PC+4) mod2^64 without changing PC.
acceptance.retry: Persist acknowledgement before fallible absolute PC write; retain phase on failure and retry PC without output.
acceptance.overlay: Reject changed-PC overlays before mutation while output is deferred; retain equal-PC and explicit replacement contracts.
acceptance.legacy: Read V4/V5 writes with retirement=None; acknowledge without another PC setter.
acceptance.complexity: O(1) retirement time/phase space; scalar payload is1/2/4/8bytes.
